ig_caption:
That number is not following you by accident.
It is a checkpoint, a small test of whether you still hear your own code, and looking away teaches the signal to whisper.
Today, stop for one breath and write down the thought you had when you saw it.
Comment NOTICED if you saw it again this week, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
